items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left and p300 right with the correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
The loop aspirates 100 uL from reservoir A1 and dispenses into each of plate row A (A1-A12) with p300; end_state:plate passed.
One tip is picked up before any aspirate and dropped at the end; the tip_before_aspirate and tip_dropped_at_end checks passed.
100 uL is within p300 limits, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the blow_out above the well is safe; all checks passed.
The protocol does exactly the one requested transfer, and the comments and metadata are accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware and transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to each of plate wells A1-A12 with the p300 using a single tip. All measured checks passed and no problems were found.
